title: Training Note: Payment Arrangement History in the Security Deposits Reconnection Multiple
content:
The Residential Credit Reestablishment Deposit assessed under Security Deposits at the reconnection of a Schedule R or Schedule FH account whose waived deposit was reinstated takes account of the member's record under Payment Arrangements (Deferred Payment Agreements).

## The rule

The arrangement adjustment is the default surcharge of **0.25** when a payment arrangement of the member was billed back on default in the last twenty-four months; it is the completed credit of **-0.10** (the multiple is lowered by 0.10) when no arrangement was billed back on default in that period and the account carries a completed payment arrangement; and it is nothing otherwise. The adjustment is added to the reconnection multiple, so the negative completed credit lowers it. The reconnection multiple is never below **2.0**; that floor is applied once, to the multiple as finally reckoned.

## Questions answered

**Which records show a default?** The arrangement ledger entries recording that an arrangement's balance was billed back on the member's bill because of a default, dated within the last twenty-four months. Any of the member's arrangements counts.

**Which records show a completed arrangement?** An arrangement on the account being reconnected whose status is completed.

**The member defaulted on an arrangement twenty months ago and later completed another on this account.**
0.25, the default surcharge; a default billed back within twenty-four months decides it whatever else the record shows.

**The member's only default was billed back thirty months ago, and a completed arrangement stands on this account.**
-0.10, the completed credit.

**No default billed back in twenty-four months and no completed arrangement on this account.**
No adjustment.

| Default billed back in the last twenty-four months | Completed arrangement on the account | Adjustment |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes or no | 0.25 |
| no | yes | -0.10 |
| no | no | nothing |
